lore.arena: This isn't a to-do list. It's an arena.
lore.reglas: Every day you have missions. Completing them earns XP and raises your level; failing them takes it away. Your streak multiplies. Big projects are campaigns with a final boss. And there's a coach who sets your day, judges you at night and remembers everything it learns about you.
lore.trampas: No cheating: proof is taken with the camera, in the moment. The system has no opinions. It logs.

nombre.codigoAyuda: If someone recommended it, enter their code. It changes nothing for you.
nombre.codigoA11y: Code of the creator who brought you, optional
nombre.codigoRechazado: {{motivo}} Fix it or continue without it.

camino.titulo: What will you use NIVL for?
camino.pista: It changes what you see first and what the coach asks of you. Everything stays available and you can change it in Profile.

objetivo.pista: One thing, in one sentence. Not “get better”: what you want to have achieved. It's what you're going to sign.
objetivo.salud: My goal includes health or training
objetivo.sinSalud: Write a general goal, with no health data. To include it, turn on the option above.

misiones.pista: Suggested for your profile ({{para}}). Remove the ones that don't fit you; you can create your own in Habits.

firma.pista: Nobody else will read it. It's sealed today and opens when the time is up. Choose how long you give yourself.
firma.letraPequena: Until then, Contract keeps it sealed. You'll write your rules and their consequences there once you're in.

coach.pista: Your habits, your organization and your progress are free. Paid plans add the AI coach and, with Élite, a badge and a request for a place in a ludus.
coach.pistaHoja: Your habits, your organization and your progress are free. Paid plans add the AI coach and, with Élite, a badge and a request for a place in a ludus. Decide now or later: the commitment counts the same.

sello.a11y: Sealed. Expires on {{fecha}}. Tap to continue

idioma.pista: It comes from your phone's language. You can change it later in Profile.

compromiso.firma: I, {{nombre}}, sign this commitment with myself on {{firmadoEl}}, the day I joined NIVL.
compromiso.promesa: I don't promise perfect days. I promise to be 1% better every day: a mission done when I don't feel like it, a rule kept when nobody is watching, an honest log when the day has gone badly.
compromiso.unoPorCiento: 1% doesn't show in a week. In {{plazo}} it's another life.
compromiso.fallo: When I fail, I won't negotiate with the system. I'll accept the penalty, carry out the consequence and come back the next day.
compromiso.apertura: To whoever opens this on {{seAbreEl}}: you are what I did with each of these days. I hope I lived up to you.
